# math.Abs and math.Sqrt map to the simd Abs and Sqrt methods. Go has no float32
# versions, so a float32 loop writes float32(math.Abs(float64(x))), which is the
# same operation: Abs is exact and Sqrt through float64 rounds to the same
# float32. The inputs include -0, infinities, NaNs, and negative numbers, and the
# output is compared bit for bit.

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

import "math"

func Abs64(dst, a []float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = math.Abs(a[i])
	}
}

func Abs32(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = float32(math.Abs(float64(a[i])))
	}
}

func Sqrt32(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = float32(math.Sqrt(float64(a[i])))
	}
}

func AbsInPlace(a []float64) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = math.Abs(a[i])
	}
}

func InvSqrt(a []float64) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = float64(1) / math.Sqrt(a[i])
	}
}

func AbsDiff(dst, a, b []float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = math.Abs(a[i] - b[i])
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"math"
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func Abs64(dst, a []float64) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = math.Abs(a[i])
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat64sPart(a[_i:])
				_v1.Abs().StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func Abs32(dst, a []float32) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = float32(math.Abs(float64(a[i])))
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(a[_i:])
				_v1.Abs().StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func Sqrt32(dst, a []float32) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = float32(math.Sqrt(float64(a[i])))
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(a[_i:])
				_v1.Sqrt().StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func AbsInPlace(a []float64) {
	for _i := 0; _i < len(a); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat64sPart(a[_i:])
		_v1.Abs().StorePart(a[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func InvSqrt(a []float64) {
	_vcBFloat64s4 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(float64(1))
	for _i := 0; _i < len(a); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat64sPart(a[_i:])
		_vcBFloat64s4.Div(_v1.Sqrt()).StorePart(a[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func AbsDiff(dst, a, b []float64) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, b) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = math.Abs(a[i] - b[i])
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			_ = b[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat64sPart(a[_i:])
				_v2, _ := simd.LoadFloat64sPart(b[_i:])
				_v1.Sub(_v2).Abs().StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, window ...int) bool {
	aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi := 0, len(a), 0, len(b)
	if len(window) == 4 {
		aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi = window[0], window[1], window[2], window[3]
	}
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	aStart, aEnd := aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size, aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
	bStart, bEnd := bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size, bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size
	return aStart < bEnd && bStart < aEnd
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"

	"example.com/test"
)

func bits64(s []float64) []string {
	out := make([]string, len(s))
	for i, v := range s {
		out[i] = fmt.Sprintf("%#x", math.Float64bits(v))
	}
	return out
}

func bits32(s []float32) []string {
	out := make([]string, len(s))
	for i, v := range s {
		out[i] = fmt.Sprintf("%#x", math.Float32bits(v))
	}
	return out
}

func main() {
	a64 := []float64{0, math.Copysign(0, -1), 1, -1, 2.5, -2.5, math.Inf(1), math.Inf(-1), math.NaN(), -math.NaN(), 4, 9, 1e-310, -1e-310, 1e300}
	dst64 := make([]float64, len(a64))
	test.Abs64(dst64, a64)
	fmt.Println(bits64(dst64))

	a32 := make([]float32, len(a64))
	for i, v := range a64 {
		a32[i] = float32(v)
	}
	dst32 := make([]float32, len(a32))
	test.Abs32(dst32, a32)
	fmt.Println(bits32(dst32))
	test.Sqrt32(dst32, a32)
	fmt.Println(bits32(dst32))

	inPlace := append([]float64(nil), a64...)
	test.AbsInPlace(inPlace)
	fmt.Println(bits64(inPlace))

	inv := []float64{1, 4, 16, 0.25, 0, -1, math.Inf(1)}
	test.InvSqrt(inv)
	fmt.Println(bits64(inv))

	b64 := []float64{1, 2, -3, 4, math.Inf(1), math.Inf(1), 1, 1, 1, 1, 4, 9, 0, 0, 1e300}
	diff := make([]float64, len(a64))
	test.AbsDiff(diff, a64, b64)
	fmt.Println(bits64(diff))
}

//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

import "math"

func Abs64(dst, a []float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = math.Abs(a[i])
	}
}

func Abs32(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = float32(math.Abs(float64(a[i])))
	}
}

func Sqrt32(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = float32(math.Sqrt(float64(a[i])))
	}
}

func AbsInPlace(a []float64) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = math.Abs(a[i])
	}
}

func InvSqrt(a []float64) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = float64(1) / math.Sqrt(a[i])
	}
}

func AbsDiff(dst, a, b []float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = math.Abs(a[i] - b[i])
	}
}
